notes.snapshot: Invoice and Receipt copy the customer name, address and product data when they are issued (a snapshot), so later changes to master data do not change them.
notes.oneInvoice: An order is billed once (order_id unique on Invoice), and an invoice has at most one payment and one receipt.
notes.computedOrderStatus: Order status (New, In Progress, Completed) is computed from the processes. It is not a column.
notes.computedStockStatus: Stock status (Normal, Low, Out) is computed from the lot totals and min_level.
